config.layer_convention: layer l = output of decoder layer l (1..L), before the final norm
config.alpha_scale: alpha x mean train token norm at the steering layer (position 0 excluded)

metrics.global_cos: mean pairwise cosine within a layer
metrics.local_angle: mean angle between adjacent tokens within a layer
metrics.cross_angle: mean angle of each token between layers m - 1 and m (0 = embeddings); steering at m itself moves only the h^m end

summary_axes: groups[group][metric][stat] is (intervention layer, alpha, measurement layer)
